The '''Candorians''' were the natives of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Candoria]]. Twenty [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], they, along with those of its colonies, were eradicated by the [[Blue Shadow Virus/Legends|Blue Shadow Virus]].
